title: Los Angeles Downtown Authentic Food Tour with 5 Local Dishes
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Please ensure to contact us in advance of the tour for any dietary requirement, to ensure we can cater for them the best we can.

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Why settle for one flavor when you can taste the world in a single neighborhood? Our Downtown Los Angeles food tour isn’t just a walk; it’s a curated journey through LA’s history. We start with the 18th century roots of Olvera Street and wind through the neon pulse of Little Tokyo.

Whether you join our lively shared tour to swap stories with other travelers or opt for a private tour for an intimate, tailored experience for your small group, you’ll go beyond the tourist traps. We’ve handpicked 6 iconic tastings that define the city: legendary French Dip Sandwiches, hand-rolled Taquitos, and savory Pork Gyoza.

Explore the bustling aisles of Grand Central Market and discover our Secret Dish, a mystery bite that changes with the seasons. Led by a local who knows the shortcuts and the stories, you’ll leave with a full stomach and the keys to the city. From Butter Chicken Samosas to hidden gems, this is the LA you came to find.
